title: The order
objective: Every listing orders ordinals by number and hashed records by creation, in its present buckets and direction, so a project of ordinals renders exactly as it does today.
body:
Seat: cc. Size: S.

## Scope

- One comparator in the waist, keyed on the id's family: ordinals first, by number; hashed records after, by `origin`.
- The store's reads that order by id or number today: `ORDER BY id` (`store.rs:5083`), issues `ORDER BY number` (`:5156-5164`) and work packages `ORDER BY seq` (`:5240-5244`); and the text sorts in ingest (`ingest.rs:1041`, `1144-1150`) and migrate (`migrate.rs:447`).
- Criteria and tests keep `id_order` in canon. `acceptance.md`'s group order follows the package order.

## Order

After WP-06. ic applies the comparator to the views in WP-10.

## Proof

`tests/unit/output_width.bats` and the view goldens are unchanged for a project of ordinals.
